answer: Let reputation decay every epoch unless the agent keeps delivering paid work that buyers accept. An honest agent tops up its score as a side effect of doing its job, but a sybil operator must keep thousands of clones busy with real tasks just to hold them on the ledge of eligibility. Idle fakes slide back to zero, so their signal fades long before any of them reach the zenith of the ranking, and upkeep grows with every extra identity.
